text: dsh-custom-mode 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的助手与自定义模式管理插件，在设置页提供多个助手的管理界面，并通过专用 API 路由读写助手状态。用户可以编辑系统提示词、选择基础模式、调整各个插件开关、查看提示词历史，也可以创建、删除、排序和修复助手；保存时会校验提示词变量并处理外部修改冲突。助手内容保存在本机 preset 文件中，创建时可选 Coding、Writing 或 Chat 起始设置。适合需要为不同任务维护独立 DSH 助手、并在新会话中切换模式的用户。需要已安装并配置好的 DSH；插件不负责安装宿主或设置模型凭据。

dsh-custom-mode manages DSH Web assistants. Edit prompts, base modes and plugin switches, create or reorder assistants, review prompt history, and save locally with variable checks and conflict detection. A configured DSH host is required.

How can I manage custom assistant modes from the DSH Web settings page?
I want to review prompt history and avoid overwriting edits made outside the editor.
dsh-custom-mode 的功能「编辑助手模式」：在设置页读取并保存助手的系统提示词、基础模式和插件开关；保存时检查提示词变量并检测文件版本冲突。
dsh-custom-mode 的功能「管理多个助手」：用户可创建、删除和排序本地助手，也可按需要修复无法解析的插件行；创建时可选择不同起始姿态。
dsh-custom-mode 的功能「提示词历史」：设置页可查看指定助手的历史版本，并从选定历史载入提示词草稿，供用户确认后保存。
dsh-custom-mode 的功能「基础模式与插件开关」：编辑器展示基础模式及其组成行，用户可调整行覆盖状态并保存为助手的组成文件。
dsh-custom-mode 的功能「助手修复与同步」：页面提供修复不可用组成行和重试注册表同步的操作，便于处理助手未能正常挂载的情况。
dsh-custom-mode 使用前须知：编辑器中的未保存草稿只保存在当前浏览器文档内，重载或关闭页面可能丢失；保存后的助手配置写入本机 preset 文件。

dsh-custom-mode README · Editing and draft safety：This section describes editing and draft protection in `2.3.1`. Confirm that exact version is available in [Releases](https://github.com/BOWLUNA/dsh-custom-mode/releases) before installing.

dsh-custom-mode README · Editing and draft safety：Select **New assistant…** in the page header to move to the existing creation form and focus its name input. Creating the assistant still requires choosing its starting settings, naming it and submitting the form. The currently selected assistant remains the editing target until creation succeeds. Enter is ignored while text is being composed; ordinary Enter submits the completed name.

dsh-custom-mode README · Editing and draft safety：Drafts remain in memory for the **current browser document**, including when you leave and return to the settings page. They are not a disk backup: reloading the document, closing the tab or restarting/unloading the plugin can lose unsaved edits. A leave-page warning cannot restore text after you confirm leaving. Copy or export important draft text first. When duplicating with pending edits, confirm that the copy uses the saved configuration; the original draft is retained.

dsh-custom-mode README · Editing and draft safety：Restoring the starting prompt, importing a file or loading saved history replaces only the prompt draft. If that would overwrite unsaved prompt text, confirm the replacement first; canceling keeps the text. Saving is still required to write the files.

dsh-custom-mode README · Editing and draft safety：If a save reports a conflict, copy the complete draft before selecting **Discard edits and reload**. A routine refresh keeps the dirty draft and its original baseline; it does not resolve the conflict. Compare the newly loaded files with your copied text before applying the intended edits again.

dsh-custom-mode README · Install and make the first request：These instructions describe version `2.3.1`. Confirm that the exact version is available in [Releases](https://github.com/BOWLUNA/dsh-custom-mode/releases), and check the [exact-host results and acceptance limits](docs/CURRENT_COMPATIBILITY.md) before installing or updating.

dsh-custom-mode README · Web / CLI：Pin the plugin version; a bare name can resolve an older build during pnpm's release cooldown:

```sh
dsh --version
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-custom-mode@2.3.1
```

Restart the process that serves this Web profile using its usual launcher. For a local CLI instance, the existing launch form is `dsh web --port 3081 --no-open`; use a free port and open the URL printed by that process. Restart only that instance. Installing a bundle does not refresh an already running host.

dsh-custom-mode README · Desktop and Windows：In the desktop app, use its **Plugins** page to install `dsh-custom-mode@2.3.1`, then restart the app. This project's scripts deliberately refuse `--profile desktop`; do not modify its profile files by hand. Windows/Electron acceptance remains separate from Web acceptance; see the compatibility record.

dsh-custom-mode README · Desktop and Windows：On Windows, the npm installation above can use the host's `dsh` command from PowerShell. Only the optional clone installer requires Git Bash (plus Node.js and npm). If `dsh` is not on PATH, use the host's supplied launcher, or replace `dsh` with `node "<host-install>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js"`. Do not point that path at this plugin's directory unless the host is actually installed there.

dsh-custom-mode README · Verify the whole path：1. Open Settings → Custom mode and check the displayed version. A page that opens is only the first check.
2. Select **New assistant…** in the page header to focus the creation form. Choose a starting setting such as Writing, enter a recognizable name and select New assistant. The created assistant becomes the editing target.
3. Set a temporary prompt such as `For the next readiness check, reply with exactly CUSTOM_MODE_READY.` Save and wait for the page to confirm that it was applied. If it says the file was saved but application failed, select Retry activation before continuing.
4. Start a **new session**, open its mode/assistant selector, and explicitly choose that named assistant. Send `Readiness check.` through a model already configured in DSH.
5. Success means the assistant is selectable without a broken-preset warning and returns the expected readiness reply without a prompt-assembly error. Restore your intended prompt after the check. If it fails, use the [current recovery steps](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#current-recovery-steps).

dsh-custom-mode README · What each choice means：The assistant selected on the settings page is the **one being edited**. Selecting or creating it does not change the assistant used by a new session. On first activation, the plugin may fill a missing default with the built-in `custom` assistant; an existing default is preserved. A newly created Writing assistant still needs to be chosen in the session selector.

dsh-custom-mode README · What each choice means：Choose the creation starting settings first; a new assistant starts from Standard. After creation, its base mode and individual plugin switches can be adjusted in its editor.

| Starting settings | Initial behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Coding | Official Standard mode, tools as shipped. |
| Writing | Official Standard mode; terminal off, file tools on. |
| Chat | Official Standard mode; files and terminal off. |

dsh-custom-mode README · What each choice means：The prompt is stored in `prompt.md` and reread when the next model step is assembled. History and file import load a draft; saving writes it. A stale save is refused when the underlying file changed. `custom_prompt` asks for approval before it writes the same file. Turning off the Identity/persona row also turns off this prompt's injection.

dsh-custom-mode README · Upgrade, clone development, and removal：The page header shows the **running plugin version**. When the host provides its native update capability, select **Check for updates** to ask the host for eligible versions. A recommended version offers **Update in Plugins**, which opens the official plugin details for its own confirmation, progress and result. The custom page does not install a package itself. Save pending drafts and resolve activation/refresh warnings before leaving the page.

dsh-custom-mode README · Upgrade, clone development, and removal：On `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.4`, `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.1.7-rc.2`, the native version-query API is absent: use **Open plugin details** or **Update guide** and the manual fixed-version path below. File, tarball and source-linked installations remain managed by their original source; checking does not silently convert them to npm. Permission denial, network failure, filtered versions or a partial result do not mean the plugin is current. A separate **Installed on disk** version does not prove that the running code has changed.

dsh-custom-mode README · Upgrade, clone development, and removal：When you update from 2.2.6 through a Web host's native Plugins page, or a failed update restores 2.2.6, restart that host once, then check the running version and assistant availability. Hot-stopping the old version can leave assistant registrations behind.

dsh-custom-mode README · Upgrade, clone development, and removal：For a manual registry upgrade, use the fixed-version npm command above with a published version, then restart the host and verify the running version. [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/BOWLUNA/dsh-custom-mode/releases) also provides the plugin `.tgz`, a preset-only import archive and `SHA256SUMS`. Verify downloaded hashes; the preset-only archive does not include the settings page.

dsh-custom-mode README · Upgrade, clone development, and removal：That command targets Web/CLI only. Desktop users must use an update path actually offered by their app. If it has none, do not substitute the Web CLI command or edit the desktop profile files.

dsh-custom-mode README · Upgrade, clone development, and removal：For source development, follow [the isolated setup](CONTRIBUTING.md#isolated-development). The optional `./install.sh --profile web` keeps the source-linked workflow and preserves existing prompt, metadata and composition. Its local package/code rollback and recovery paths are explained in [package and release assets](docs/PUBLISHING.md#package-and-release-assets).

dsh-custom-mode README · Upgrade, clone development, and removal：`./uninstall.sh` removes the plugin but keeps assistant data. `--purge` explicitly deletes the managed assistant directories and their prompts; keep your own backup before using it. In `2.3.1`, a failed or unverifiable host removal stops cleanup and purge, preserves the remaining files and exits with an error. Resolve the reported host error before retrying; desktop removal stays in the app's Plugins page.

dsh-custom-mode README · Compatibility and versioning：Declared host range: `>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.1.6-alpha.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.1.7-alpha.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.2.1-alpha.1 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.2.2-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0`

dsh-custom-mode README · Compatibility and versioning：The plugin version is its own stable `x.y.z` line; it does not mirror DSH. On 2026-11-04 the public host tags were `latest=0.2.1-rc.5`, `next=0.2.2-rc.1`, and `alpha=0.2.2-alpha.3`. Tags move; the declared range and completed checks are separate facts. See [exact versions, acceptance limits and historical evidence](docs/CURRENT_COMPATIBILITY.md) for the tested scope.

dsh-custom-mode README · Compatibility and versioning：Release requires the compatibility and browser workflows. The unit runner, real prompt-component checks, packed-install checks and browser checks cover different boundaries. Windows/Electron, a real model response and GPU execution must each have their own evidence; they are not inferred from a page screenshot or unit count. Headless mode does not start an agent-preset session.

dsh-custom-mode README · Plugin markets：The documented catalogs use different discovery and approval rules. Their 2026-10-09 listing results are historical, so a package may not be searchable in every market today. The fixed-version installation above remains the direct path. [Market interfaces and limits](docs/MARKETPLACES.md) explains the read-only adapter; it never executes catalog-provided shell commands or submits a listing.
